title: Fix Motoko backend to support all create/upload operations across all four admin sections

requirements.text: Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement create/upload operations for comment lists — including creating new lists, adding templates, setting inventory counts, renaming, deleting, and locking/unlocking — so that no 'Backend does not support creating comment lists yet' errors are returned.

quotes: Backend does not support creating comment lists yet.

acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new comment list via the admin panel succeeds without error
Adding templates to a comment list persists and returns correctly
Setting inventory count on a list persists correctly
Renaming, deleting, and locking/unlocking comment lists all work without errors
No 'does not support' error messages are returned for any comment list operation

requirements.text: Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement create/upload operations for app events (live lists) — including creating new events, adding usernames in bulk, deleting events, and auto-importing parsed live list reports — so that all admin live list operations succeed.

quotes: all four admin section method also check full website features ensure all work smoothly

acceptanceCriteria: Creating a new app event/live list entry via the admin panel persists correctly
Bulk uploading usernames to an event succeeds and data is stored
Deleting an event removes it from storage
Auto-importing a parsed live list report populates the backend correctly
No 'does not support' errors are returned for any app event operation

requirements.text: Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement create/set/regenerate operations for the access key — so that setting and regenerating an access key from the admin settings panel persists and is validated correctly.

quotes: all four admin section method also check full website features ensure all work smoothly

acceptanceCriteria: Setting a new access key from admin settings persists in backend state
Regenerating the access key produces a new value and persists it
The stored access key is correctly validated when users attempt to generate comments
No 'does not support' errors are returned for access key operations

requirements.text: Fix the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo to fully implement music upload and settings operations — including enabling/disabling background music and storing/updating the music URL — so that all admin music/settings operations succeed.

quotes: all four admin section method also check full website features ensure all work smoothly

acceptanceCriteria: Uploading or updating the background music URL via admin settings persists correctly
Toggling background music enabled/disabled state persists correctly
The frontend background music hook reads the correct state from the backend
No 'does not support' errors are returned for music/settings operations

requirements.text: Audit and fix the Motoko backend actor to ensure all other backend-supported operations work correctly end-to-end: chat messages (addChatMessage, fetching messages), images (upload, list, tags), pricing (add, edit, delete, bulk upload), withdrawal requests (check, submit, list), and the midnight countdown — ensuring no operation returns a stub or unsupported error.

quotes: check full website features ensure all work smoothly

acceptanceCriteria: Chat messages can be added and fetched without errors
Images can be uploaded with name and tags and listed correctly
Pricing entries can be added, edited, deleted, and bulk uploaded
Withdrawal requests can be submitted and listed by admin
Countdown and settings data are returned correctly by the backend
No backend function returns a placeholder or 'not supported' error

constraints: No frontend UI changes — backend Motoko code only
All logic must remain in a single actor in backend/main.mo
Do not change existing data type definitions unless strictly required to fix a broken operation
nonGoals: Adding new frontend features or views
Adding new data types or features not already present in the codebase
